b.x: 01 · What it actually is

Relative autonomy. Not romantic isolation. You stay in the city, in the family, at work. You just do not hand the whole Tuesday to a single point of failure: the tap, the pole, the till, the corner hospital. Whoever prepares in silence increases margin. Whoever prepares to be right about collapse becomes a poster.
NOTE
This guide is educational. It does not replace an in-person course, a doctor, or a lawyer. Print the family plan and leave it at home — not in the group chat.
02 · The Rule of Threes
Order of dying and of deciding. Not poetry. A queue.
01 Air — minutes. Smoke, gas, water in the face. Leave. Not a hero.
02 Shelter — hours. Cold, heat, rain, a roof. The house first.
03 Water — days. Three to four litres per person per day.
04 Food — weeks. Hunger lies. Thirst kills first.
05 Hope and safety — the nervous system. Without that the rest becomes a stage.
03 · Mindset

Accept the problem early. Drill on the easy day. Spend fewer decisions. Tuesday’s blackout does not ask for a speech. It asks for the torch that was already in place. Whoever denies until the water rises decides late — and badly. Gray is not a pessimist. Gray already rehearsed the second plan while the first still worked.
Name the risk in one line. No film tone.
Rehearse on Saturday what Monday will not forgive.
One decision at a time. A list. Not a meeting.
04 · Written family plan
If it is not on paper, it does not exist when the network drops. One page. Large type. On the fridge and in the bag — not only on the phone.
Near meeting point (neighbour, square, lobby).
Far meeting point (kin outside the neighbourhood).
Two walking routes. One vehicle route. A stay-or-leave rule.
Who fetches child / elder. A three-word agreed message.
Out-of-town contact. Number on paper, not only in the phone.
DO
Leave rule: water on the pavement, Civil Defense order, smoke in the hall, a door that will not hold. If the rule fires, do not debate in the gap.
05 · Water
Three to four litres per person per day — drink, cook, minimum hygiene. A family of four, three days: about 40 litres. Not drama. Marked jugs, away from cleaning chemicals.
01 Store: opaque jug, capped, rotated every six months.
02 Boil one minute at low altitude; three at altitude.
03 Ceramic or straw filter if the water is cloudy — then boil.
04 Unscented household bleach (check the label): two drops per litre of clear water; wait 30 minutes. Do not mix recipes. If unsure, boil.
NOTE
Purification techniques — boil, filter, chlorine, SODIS, what each kills and what none of them kill — live in the Purification field.
06 · Food

Pantry method — what the family already eats. Rice, beans, pasta, cans, oil, salt, sugar, milk powder, sardines. Do not buy movie rations. Buy what hits Tuesday’s plate. Dates visible. First to expire, first out. A garden is extra: herbs and leaf. It is not the three-day plan.
DO
Two or three plates that need no fridge. One can opener. A stove that does not depend only on the grid. Cooking water counts in the day’s litres.
07 · Shelter and clothing

A house that stays livable off-grid is worth more than a new tent. Seals, one room, a window that shuts, a roof that does not drip on a wire. Clothes: layers, dry in a bag, shoes that walk. Field means improvising shade and wind — not pitching camp in the building gap. In Brazil heat kills more ‘extreme cold’ rehearsal than the reverse. Water, shade, wind, roof.
08 · Fire

Three legal ignitions: lighter, waterproof matches, the stove you already have. Tinder: cotton, dry paper, straw. Outside, fire is a decision — wind, vegetation, burn law. Inside, alcohol and a tin in the gap is an accident. Cook where cooking already happens. Put it out. Water on the embers. Do not film it.
DON'T
Do not light in dry brush, the corridor, the lift, the neighbour’s yard. Illegal burning is not survival. It is a case file.
09 · Health and hygiene

An in-person first-aid course is worth more than a pretty kit. Emergency services. Recovery position. Pressure on bleeding. Do not improvise medicine. A real pharmacy: what the family already takes, labels visible, plus dressings, oral rehydration, a painkiller the doctor already allowed, a thermometer. Sanitation: closed trash, waste away from water, hands. In Brazil, dengue and leptospirosis after flood matter more than jungle fantasy. Standing water. Rats. Feet in mud. Vaccines on time are not a stage — they are margin.
10 · Security

Discretion. A closed house that does not look like a bunker. Light in the gap, not a spotlight. Avoid confrontation. Speak less. Emergency numbers exist. Weapons only inside the law — licence, storage, your state’s rules. This guide does not teach use, room-clearing, or reloading. Whoever turns a blackout into a show of force becomes a target and a case. Gray vanishes. Gray does not pose.
DON'T
Do not post stores, a generator, a weapon, a route. The room reads it. So does the thief.
11 · EDC, 72 h, and the house store

Three rings. What leaves with you (EDC). What leaves if the house fails (72 hours). What stays if you stay (pantry, water, meds, papers). If the middle ring weighs like a move, you will not leave. If the inner ring is an arsenal, you are a stage on the street.
EDC: ID, small cash, one card, phone, light, 24 h of meds, keys.
72 h: water, ready food, battery radio, power bank, copy of ID, a layer, a simple kit.
House: the pantry, the litres, the family pharmacy, the plan on the fridge.
12 · Power and communication

Battery radio. A power bank charged on Tuesday. A torch. An analogue agreement: place, hour, three words. The phone is excellent until it is not. Do not depend on an app to find the child. Do not run a generator in a building well without law and without neighbours. Silence on the network is worth more than an ‘I am prepared’ status.
13 · Navigation and movement

A paper map of the neighbourhood. Two walking routes drilled in daylight. Move at night only if the rule says so. Do not follow the herd onto the overpass. Fuel in the tank on Tuesday — not on the Sunday of the event. On foot, gray walks like someone who lives there. No vest. No well-step.
14 · Skills you trade and skills you use

What you can do on a Tuesday is worth more than what you bought on Saturday. Cook with what is there. Stop a bleed. Read a map. Fix a leak. Care for a child without a screen. Trade: a neighbour with a generator, you with water; someone with a car, you with the plan. The lone wolf does not trade. That is why he lasts little.
15 · Papers and cash
Dry copies: ID, proof of address, prescription, contacts. A bag. Not the original in the street bag.
Small cash in two places. Not a wad. Not in the same pocket as the phone.
A stick or paper with numbers. The cloud dies with the lights.
16 · Family and neighbours

The lone wolf is a film myth. Who lasts three days already knows the porter, the neighbour in 302, the cousin outside the neighbourhood. A short agreement. No collapse lecture. Do not enlist the building. One concrete favour: water, radio, fetch a child. Gray does not lead a lobby militia. Gray is what the street does not point at.
17 · Concrete Brazil

Flood, blackout, heat, empty shelves, the street. Not an alpine winter. Not a meteor. Who lives by a river has a leave-rule before the slab. Who lives in a flat has a drilled stair and water on the floor. Who depends on insulin does not play with the fridge. Civil Defense, weather service, cell broadcast on the phone. Media fear is not the datum. The datum is the river gauge and the hour to leave.
18 · Six-month drill
01 One night without power on purpose. What was missing goes on the list.
02 Rotate water and cans. Dates. Bin the expired.
03 Walk both routes with the family. A clock. No stage.
04 Read the plan aloud. One correction. Back on the fridge.
19 · Ethics and law

Surviving does not cancel the code. Theft, assault, an illegal weapon, fire in brush, a militia well — that is not gray. It is a case and a stage. The guide stops at the law. Help who fits without exposing yourself. Do not loot. Do not take justice into your own hands. Emergency services, Civil Defense. The rest is film.
20 · The 30-day minimum
An ordinary family. No well. No extra film salary. Thirty days to be objectively safer.
01 Days 1–7: one-page plan. Near and far points. Leave rule. Numbers on paper.
02 Days 8–14: three days of water. Torch. Battery radio. Copies of ID.
03 Days 15–21: pantry of what you already eat. Can opener. 72 h of meds. Power bank.
04 Days 22–30: EDC in the pocket. A light 72-hour bag. One night without power. One walking route.
DO
The clickable list is in Kits → 30 days. Print it. Tick it. Do not post it.
